introduction: Explore the Plane of Smoke, return Korli’s spectacles, fulfill Rijak’s heart request and understand Erk’s four exact equipment services. Follow declared planar and vault routes while keeping current supplies, accepted outcomes and pending native repair decisions distinct.
orientation: Active, ready accounting is mandatory for discovery, visible encounters, journals and new achievement/daily credit. Discovering Smoke has its own achievement. Questions, current inventory, attempted access and scenic lore do not complete quests.

The two accepted delivery stories are Rijak’s heart exchange and Korli’s spectacles return. Erk’s two-blade forging, ring/earring conversions and staff enhancement are four equipment services with history but no quest achievement or daily credit. Supplied exact materials need no personal kill or producer history.

Smoke has no ordinary exit to another zone. The older Plane of Air portal at 24405 leads to Korli’s fresh-air pocket 139832; the older Plane of Fire portal at 25464 leads to the fire pocket and locked box 139894. Local blue and red portals return to those older planes. These are distinct from the later Air and Fire areas.

The main smoke grid spans five layers with six-direction travel. Magical darkness and blocked sight affect perception. Most rooms are actually Fire Plane terrain, so shared heat hazards apply. Fresh-air and sphere/vortex rooms are Air Plane terrain; flight and surviving arrival matter. The fresh-air pocket is not flagged safe.

At Ehkahk’s lair 139863, the disc leads to Sphere of Smoke 139937; its counterpart returns to the lair. Rijak starts at 139940, whose separate smoky portal leads one way to vault antechamber 139941. The antechamber’s south route returns to the grid, so this does not certify personal use of Rijak’s portal.

Rijak’s veil and vault key require heart 139808, not Etrita’s different heart. Both are ordinary preloaded trophies; the exchange does not validate a personal kill. Rijak and Erk may wander, while Korli is sentinel. Potential daily metadata does not guarantee renewable recipients, rare actors or proof supplies.

Korli’s spectacles are declared on the second twenty-five-percent mephit follower at 139875. Returning them grants obsidian key 139812 and retires Korli. His described sight recovery and disappearance are narrative; the native transaction does not equip the glasses, cure blindness or record escort or homecoming.

The trapped, closed, locked and pickproof obsidian box at 139894 holds Hate. Its key and the vault key both have a one-hundred-percent break roll on accepted unlock. Possession, unlocking, break settlement, opening and loose recovery are separate. A historical key receipt neither opens today’s lock nor restores a spent key.

The vault portcullis now names the rewarded vault key 139818 on both sides. Unlocking changes reciprocal lock flags but leaves the door closed and pickproof; opening remains separate. The northern door from vault 139942 to forge 139945 resets closed but unlocked. Existing shared state and alternate supplied materials still matter.

Discontent is a different broadsword from Hate, carried by forty-percent Charzzlk at 139863. Newly loaded Discontent can be selected by its own name and retains its old aliases. Two copies of Hate cannot satisfy Erk’s two-kind forging bundle. First acquisition, original source and another player’s handoff are not distinguished by this inventory check.

The human ring, half-elf earring and grey-elf staff are equipped on separate forty-percent vault occupants. Recover them to loose inventory. The ring is shared by conversion and enhancement recipes; spending it once does not reserve another. Reversible jewelry services create no daily or quest achievement loop.

The Smouldering Forge room 139945 currently uses Negative Plane terrain and schedules life-force drain. Its forge object is an ordinary container with no operating quest procedure. Builder review must select intended terrain. The exit down to 139944 reaches blue/red return portals; there is no ordinary upward return from that exodus room.

Erk’s greatsword currently includes a permanent Power effect. Its intended abilities need builder review before combat or stat growth becomes a story objective. This journal records the accepted forging service and explains its materials.

Ehkahk carries imported epic stone 359. Its shared touch procedure uses live zone, peaceful-room/group and committed claim checks; holding the stone or delivering the heart does not prove a personal victory or a completed group claim. Frozen obligation recovery stays separate from active-accounting publication.

Concubine captivity, commander followers, the conjurer, elemental vortices and unused holding/rare rooms have no additional native quest terminals. Builder-selected rescue, obstacle, combat, travel or campaign events would need actual accepted transitions before new progress. Preserve exact identities and explain incomplete intent openly.

contacts.name: Rijak, the exiled Sorcerer of Smoke
contacts.description: Rijak starts in Sphere of Smoke 139940 and can wander within the zone. Ask about Ehkahk, dead and proof for the heart request. Acceptance grants a veil and vault key, then retires him; narrative vengeance is not a separate personal-kill objective.

contacts.name: Korli, the Halfling adventurer
contacts.description: Korli starts in the Pocket of Fresh Air 139832 and is sentinel. His lost spectacles yield the obsidian key and retirement. The room blocks ordinary mobile entry but is not flagged safe; Air Plane movement requires actual flight. The literal default alias is not a wildcard response.

contacts.name: Erk, the forgemaster
contacts.description: Erk starts at the Smouldering Forge 139945 and can wander within the zone. His four exact, non-retiring equipment services are distinct from quest achievements. The forge room currently has Negative Plane terrain and schedules life-force damage, despite its fire imagery; the forge object itself is scenery. The literal default alias is not a wildcard.

contacts.name: Ehkahk, the Prince of the Para-Elemental Plane of Smoke
contacts.description: Ehkahk starts in the Elemental Prince’s Lair 139863 carrying the quest heart and imported epic stone 359. His equipped elemental attack object has an actual packed combat spell bundle. The preloaded heart, personal defeat and committed group stone claim are different facts; none grants inferred rescue credit.

contacts.name: A smoke mephit
contacts.description: Mephits occupy many Smoke rooms. Korli’s spectacles specifically follow the second, twenty-five-percent F at 139875. Earlier and later mephits there are separate actors; source presence and admitted item generation are not guaranteed.

contacts.name: Charzzlk, the ash elemental
contacts.description: Charzzlk has a forty-percent M command at 139863 and carries Discontent. He is separate from the conjurer and Ehkahk. Recovering his broadsword does not prove this player’s personal combat or first acquisition.

contacts.name: A Human Concubine
contacts.description: The human concubine has a forty-percent M command in vault 139942 and declares the jewel-encrusted ring equipped in finger slot 1. She can wander within the zone. Captivity lore has no actual escort, release or return-home contract.

contacts.name: A Half-Elf Concubine
contacts.description: The half-elf concubine has a forty-percent M command in vault 139942 and declares the jewel-encrusted earring equipped in slot 1. That finger slot matches its present wear flag, although its name suggests an earring. Repair needs builder intent; supplied exact earrings remain valid service material.

contacts.name: A Grey Elf Concubine
contacts.description: The grey-elf concubine has a forty-percent M command in vault 139942 and declares the ordinary staff of smoke and fire equipped in hold slot 18. It must be loose for offering. Erk’s shared-keyword enhanced staff is a different kind.

contacts.name: Roj'lik
contacts.description: Rojlik starts in vault antechamber 139941. The one-way Sphere portal leads into this antechamber, whose south route returns to the smoke grid. He supplies no native quest, key-acceptance or escort endpoint.

contacts.name: The great smoke dragon, 'Etrita'
contacts.description: Etrita has a twenty-percent M command in Spawning Room 139935 with a different heart 139810. Her heart cannot replace Ehkahk’s requested heart 139808. Birth-room and flight routes do not establish a rescue or key quest.

contacts.name: A smoke mephit commander
contacts.description: The mephit commander has a sixty-percent M command in Spawning Room 139935 and declares his own followers and gauntlets. Actual cap, admitted spawn and last-M follower parenting matter; he is not the spectacles source or a native quest recipient.

The heart is declared as an ordinary carried trophy on Ehkahk, not a death-generated proof of your personal victory. Current exact delivery is the accepted outcome. The key opens the vault portcullis from either side but has a one-hundred-percent break roll on accepted unlock; opening, surviving entry and renewable supplies are separate.
